description: Market-wide Fear & Greed index (0-100 plus label) as the median of independent sources (CoinMarketCap, Alternative.me, CoinGlass), with every source's own value, label and observation time in `sources`. `agreement` (aligned/mixed/divergent) says how far the sources differ; a source older than 36h is listed but excluded from the median. Sources publish at different cadences (CoinMarketCap about every 15 minutes, the others daily), so read `observedAt`/`ageSeconds` per source. A macro sentiment gauge; use market_overview for the full market snapshot.
name: sentiment_fear_greed

asOf.description: ISO 8601 time of the newest observation among the sources that counted

label.description: Index band for `value`, e.g. Fear or Greed

sources.description: Every source asked, whether or not it counted

expectedNextUpdateAt.description: ISO 8601 time the source should next publish

note.description: Why a source did not count, or a caveat on one that did

observedAt.description: ISO 8601 time the source says the value was computed

value.description: The source's own reading, 0-100 (absent when it failed)

spread.description: max - min across the counted sources

value.description: Consensus Fear & Greed index, 0-100: the median of the sources that counted

title: Fear & Greed Index
